newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia says expects credit rating by end of 1996.
newsitem.headline: Croatia says expects credit rating by end of 1996.

text.p: Croatia has submitted documents for an international credit assessment and expects to obtain a sovereign rating before the end of 1996, a Finance Ministry official said on Tuesday.
"It will definitely happen by year end," Assistant Minister Hrvoje Radovanic told Reuters by telephone.
He said the government expected interviews by international rating agencies to begin toward the end of October or beginning of November. But there was no precise schedule yet.
Croatia is aiming for a "BBB" investment grade rating so as to tap vital funds for its post-war reconstruction from large foreign institutional investors.
Last Friday, it engaged as rating advisers Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) and U.S. investment bank Merril Lynch.
The Finance Ministry said the two would subsequently be awarded the mandate to arrange its maiden Eurobond issue, set at approximately $150 million.
